subject: Align Plots in row on top of each other

messages.author: 7b686cee16ef4d9d
messages.subject: Align Plots in row on top of each other
parts:
Dear Community,

I need only a final adivce to be happy with my figures...

1.) I create three figures: (like following)

bi42<-ggplot(reg1_42,aes(treat,biov,fill=treat))+geom_boxplot(fill=c("white","grey60","grey80"),width=0.8,size=0.8, colour="black")+
  theme_bw()+
  xlab("Treatments")+
  ylab(expression(paste(log~biovolume~"[",µm^3~L^-1,"]")))+
  annotate("text",size=8,x=2,y=18.64,label="a")+
  annotate("text",size=8,x=1,y=19.1,label="b")+
  annotate("text",size=8,x=3,y=19.14,label="b")+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(),axis.title.x=element_blank())+
  theme(axis.text.y=element_text(size=14,colour="black",face="bold"),axis.title.y=element_text(size=18,colour="black",vjust=0.3))+
  geom_segment(data=whiskers,aes(x=as.numeric(treat)-0.1,y=lower,xend=as.numeric(treat)+0.1,yend=lower),size=0.8)+
  geom_segment(data=whiskers,aes(x=as.numeric(treat)-0.1,y=upper,xend=as.numeric(treat)+0.1,yend=upper),size=0.8)+
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank())+
  theme(panel.border=element_rect(size=1.5,colour="black"))+
  theme(axis.ticks.length=unit(0.3,"cm"))+
  theme(axis.ticks=element_line(size=1.2))

ri42<-ggplot(reg1_42,aes(treat,rich,fill=treat))+geom_boxplot(fill=c("white","grey60","grey80"),width=0.8,size=0.8, colour="black")+
  theme_bw()+
  ylab("Species richness")+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(),axis.title.x=element_blank())+
  theme(axis.text.y=element_text(size=14,colour="black",face="bold"),axis.title.y=element_text(size=18,colour="black",vjust=0.3))+
  geom_segment(data=whiskers1,aes(x=as.numeric(treat)-0.1,y=lower,xend=as.numeric(treat)+0.1,yend=lower),size=0.8)+
  geom_segment(data=whiskers1,aes(x=as.numeric(treat)-0.1,y=upper,xend=as.numeric(treat)+0.1,yend=upper),size=0.8)+
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank())+
  theme(panel.border=element_rect(size=1.5,colour="black"))+
  theme(axis.ticks.length=unit(0.3,"cm"))+
  theme(axis.ticks=element_line(size=1.2))

ev42<-ggplot(reg1_42,aes(treat,even,fill=treat))+geom_boxplot(fill=c("white","grey60","grey80"),width=0.8,size=0.8, colour="black")+
  theme_bw()+
  xlab("Treatments")+
  ylab("Evenness")+
  annotate("text",size=8,x=1,y=0.665,label="a")+
  annotate("text",size=8,x=2,y=0.778,label="b")+
  annotate("text",size=8,x=3,y=0.768,label="ab")+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=14,colour="black",face="bold"),axis.title.x=element_text(size=18,colour="black",vjust=0.1))+
  theme(axis.text.y=element_text(size=14,colour="black",face="bold"),axis.title.y=element_text(size=18,colour="black",vjust=0.3))+
  geom_segment(data=whiskers2,aes(x=as.numeric(treat)-0.1,y=lower,xend=as.numeric(treat)+0.1,yend=lower),size=0.8)+
  geom_segment(data=whiskers2,aes(x=as.numeric(treat)-0.1,y=upper,xend=as.numeric(treat)+0.1,yend=upper),size=0.8)+
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank())+
  theme(panel.border=element_rect(size=1.5,colour="black"))+
  theme(axis.ticks.length=unit(0.3,"cm"))+
  theme(axis.ticks=element_line(size=1.2))+
  geom_segment(aes(x=2,y=0.5966,xend=2,yend=0.4853),size=0.5)

And than I used grid.arrange (bi42,ri42,ev42) to plot them on one page: (see above)

My Problem is now:

How can I align the y-axis + title (left side) of all three plots, that they are exactly on top of each other? (In the moment they are y-axis title aligned)
Shall I change the xlim or plot.size?

Thanks in advance
Nils
